# Open Helpdesk

> Open-source helpdesk with built-in multi-tenant support. Perfect for MSPs, agencies, and teams managing multiple clients. Self-host or use our cloud.

## About

Open Helpdesk is a ticket management platform that lets you manage support for multiple clients from a single dashboard. Each client gets an isolated workspace with their own tickets, agents, settings, and branding. Organize work with projects, departments, organizations, and custom categories. Licensed under AGPL-3.0.

## Key Features

- **Multi-Workspace**: Each client or team gets an isolated workspace with dedicated tickets, agents, and data
- **Tickets**: Create, assign, and track support tickets with priorities, statuses, categories, and custom fields
- **Projects**: Group tickets by project within a workspace
- **Departments & Organizations**: Organize agents into departments and contacts into organizations with domain-based auto-enrollment
- **Tags**: Classify and filter tickets with custom labels
- **Email-to-Ticket**: Turn incoming emails into tickets automatically via IMAP mailboxes
- **Email Rules**: Automatically route, categorize, or assign incoming emails based on conditions
- **Customer Portal**: Public ticket submission form, no login required. Customers track via magic link
- **Knowledge Base**: Public help articles organized by category, per workspace
- **SLA Tracking**: Response and resolution targets per priority with real-time breach detection
- **CSAT Surveys**: Automatic satisfaction surveys after ticket resolution
- **Reports & Analytics**: Visual dashboard with resolution times, agent performance, and trends
- **Kanban Board**: Drag-and-drop ticket management with list and board views
- **Canned Responses**: Reusable reply templates inserted with "/" while writing
- **Custom Fields**: Text, dropdowns, dates, checkboxes, and more
- **Audit Log**: Full traceability of every action
- **AI Tools**: Improve ticket descriptions and translate between languages
- **Integrations**: REST API, webhooks, and API keys to connect with any external system
- **Embeddable**: Token exchange API to embed the helpdesk into your own product in 20 minutes
- **Self-Hosted**: Deploy on your own servers. Your data stays yours

## Pricing

- **Free**: 2 agents, 1 workspace, unlimited tickets, reports, custom fields, email-to-ticket
- **Starter** ($15/mo): 5 agents, 3 workspaces, CSAT, SLA tracking, canned responses
- **Business** ($39/mo): 20 agents, 10 workspaces, audit log, advanced reports, custom mailboxes
- **Enterprise**: Custom limits, dedicated setup, volume pricing, unlimited AI
- **Self-Hosted**: Free forever, no limits, AGPL-3.0

Extra agent seats: $9/mo each. 14-day free trial on paid plans, no credit card required.

Pricing is subject to change. For current plans and pricing visit https://openhelpdesk.dev/pricing

## FAQ

### Is Open Helpdesk really free?
Yes. The core product is free and open-source under AGPL-3.0. Self-host at no cost. Paid cloud plans are available for teams needing more agents, workspaces, and features.

### Can I self-host it?
Yes. Docker images and docker-compose file get you running in under 5 minutes. Deploy on any VPS, Kubernetes, or bare metal.

### How is it different from other helpdesks?
Multi-workspace is built in (most helpdesks are single-tenant). Plans include agent seats with $9/mo extras instead of $55+/agent. Plus it's open-source.

### Can I embed it in my product?
Yes. One API call authenticates your users via token exchange. No SDKs, no separate login. Full helpdesk that feels native to your product.
